ordered_diagnoses: basal cell carcinoma with vascular features

candidates.name: Kaposi's sarcoma
support_spans: Band-like vascular proliferation in the upper dermis with no grenz zone
Round vascular spaces lined by a single layer of endothelial cells
Vascular channel endothelial cells were positive for CD34 and CD31
candidates.why: The presence of band-like vascular proliferation and round vascular spaces lined by a single layer of endothelial cells, along with the positivity for CD34 and CD31, are characteristic features of Kaposi's sarcoma.

candidates.name: angioma
support_spans: Round vascular spaces lined by a single layer of endothelial cells
contradict_spans: No hemosiderin deposits found with Perls Prussian blue stain
candidates.why: The presence of round vascular spaces is a feature of angioma, but the lack of hemosiderin deposits and other specific characteristics make it a less likely diagnosis.
